submission.justification: Algorithm-L1 has the highest signal efficiency in the simulation scan, 92.08% at 40 GeV. L3 reaches 85.1% and L2 reaches 74.8%. The recorded results contain no latency data for any candidate, so the 4.0 us hard limit is unverified for all three, including L1. The results also contain no trigger rate per threshold, so the 8 kHz allocation is unconfirmed too. This recommendation is provisional. Before deployment, confirm that L1 latency on the FPGA is at most 4.0 us and that its rate at 40 GeV fits within 8 kHz. If L1 fails the latency check, fall back to L3 at 35 GeV (85.1%), then L2 at 30 GeV (74.8%).
